mapper.update: UPDATE dish SET dish_name = #{dishName}, dish_introduction = #{dishIntroduction}, price = #{price}, category = #{category}, spicy_level = #{spicyLevel} WHERE dish_number = #{dishNumber}
UPDATE dish SET dish_status = #{dishStatus} WHERE dish_number = #{dishNumber}
